events.title: Event Schedule Update
events.summary: Availability for Event 2 songs has been extended, Event 3 will be postponedTo make sure every update feels more impactful, we're moving away from a monthly event update format, we want to make sure that every updates we release remains quality you guys deserve, and yes, lately we’ve been cooking something much bigger than a standard monthly 3 songs update...Expect more news and some sneak peeks soon, stay tuned!

events.title: DEMO Event 1 "Echoes of Infinity" is Now Live!
events.summary: The "Event - Echoes of Infinity" chapter has appeared in the game! Make sure to update Estella on Steam and restart the game to see it. Before diving in, a few notes: This is a DEMO event test—the flow is for preview only and differs from full release. All event songs will return fully in Early Access.Got issues or feedback? Report on our discord!Chapter available for 14 days only. Miss it and you can't unlock, but Ratings are safe forever!

events.title: Estella’s First DEMO Event — "Echoes of Infinity" Rule Rundown
events.summary: Our first DEMO event, “Echoes of Infinity”, will begin on January 16th, 7:00 AM (EST)!In this event, a small playable chapter will also be released for everyone to explore and experience.Special Rules:The boss track INFiNiTE ENERZY -Overdoze- appears in Extreme Mode.Any GOOD, BAD, or MISS will result in instant failure, and only Glitched difficulty is available.Easier difficulties will unlock 1 day later, with the health gauge becoming more lenient over time.Good luck everyone...

events.title: 20,000 Wishlists Reached!
events.summary: We are thrilled to announce that Estella has officially surpassed 20,000 wishlists!A huge thank you to everyone who has supported us so far.Seeing all of you guys hop on playing and making contents brings joy into our heart, your support is the best fuel we could ask for!We are working hard behind the scenes to make the game the best it can be, stay tuned and keep grinding!
